bearer.description: A session token (login) or an API token (read-only).

info.description: Read the slow-query history, plans, index recommendations and explanations PgLens keeps for each monitored database. queryid is a string everywhere (a signed 64-bit value). Numbers named measured… are summed pg_stat_statements deltas; estimated… and plannerCost… are planner estimates.
